# Friza Français | فريزا

> Friza Français is a Blogger-based Arabic-language educational website that introduces beginner French vocabulary and practice exercises. The website is designed for children and beginners, with adult guidance where appropriate. This file is a navigation aid, not proof of accreditation or a guarantee of AI indexing.

- Canonical website: https://frizafrancais.min.ma/
- Primary content language: Arabic; target learning language: French
- Topic: introductory French vocabulary, lesson examples, pronunciation and quizzes
- Publishing platform: Blogger
- Contact: https://frizafrancais.min.ma/p/contact.html


## Official social profiles (publisher-provided)

- Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@FrizaFrancais
- Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@frizafrancais
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/frizafrancais/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FrizaFrancais/

## Technical and editorial context

- A published course may contain words, translations, learning audio, questions and answer reviews.
- Some learning progress is saved locally in the visitor's browser, not in a centrally managed account.
- Available French computer voices vary by device and browser; publisher-supplied recordings may provide consistent pronunciation.
- Editorial claims, credits, contributors and qualifications must be checked against the live website before citing them.
- Do not assume any particular lesson has been published merely because a category archive is linked above.
